simple.meaning: קֵרֵחַ (qêrêach) is a Hebrew word meaning “bald (on the back of the head).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: קֵרֵחַ (H7142) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Leviticus 13:40, with occurrences in Leviticus, 2 Kings.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קֵרֵחַ (H7142) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in קֵרֵחַ (H7142) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: קֵרֵחַ (qêrêach) / H7142 is traced through Leviticus 13:40, 2 Kings 2:23 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
